assessment.md.content:
# Independent blinded review: candidate 4

## Scope and provenance
Only candidate-4/source.md, acceptance.md, inventory.json and tree/ were used as contestant material. The inventory records every module as a **working draft**. No TARGETS.md, claimed A–E target map, or submitted final target appears in tree/.

## Mathematical mapping
| Goal | Candidate content | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| A: actual HGP construction | `Paper.HGP.Data`, `QubitIndex`, `xCheck`, `zCheck`, `complex`, `zLogical`, `xLogical`, and four input-code aliases | Correctly intended aliases to supplied QECert objects. The X check is boundary1Matrix; the Z check is transposed boundary2Matrix. The negative sign in the supplied first boundary is the required positive sign over F₂. Logical spaces are honest middle homology/cohomology quotients. This is construction scaffolding, not a new parameter theorem. |
| A: commutation, length, k formula, both-sector distance | No contestant theorem | Not completed. The chain-complex alias inherits supplied boundary-squared validity; the source does not state/prove the requested conclusions using its aliases. |
| B | No support subspace, supported logical image, supported dimensions, rank identities, or complement theorem | Not completed. |
| C | No errors, same-syndrome equivalence, failure definition, or distance characterization | Not completed. |
| D | No strip definition or universal Z/X formula | Not completed. |
| E1/E2 | No concrete HGP inputs or call sites | Not completed. |

## What is actually written
`HGPExperiment.Paper.HGP.Model` contains exactly eleven abbreviations and zero named contestant theorems. Its four kernel-code aliases are `firstKernel`, `secondKernel`, `firstTransposeKernel`, and `secondTransposeKernel`. `Smoke` contains the arithmetic example `(1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0`; `Tiny` and `Core` contain only `1 + 1 = 2`. Those examples do not establish any target mathematics.

No novel mathematical statement is claimed by name or verified. In particular, importing the supplied library's full parameter theorem in `Smoke` is not an instantiation, application, or proof of A/E in the contestant development.

## Exact reduction to the pinned supplied library
| Contestant abbreviation | Definitional expansion |
|---|---|
| `Paper.HGP.Data` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2)` |
| `Paper.HGP.QubitIndex` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.QubitIndex` |
| `Paper.HGP.xCheck H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix H` |
| `Paper.HGP.zCheck H` | `(QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary2Matrix H).transpose` |
| `Paper.HGP.complex H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H` |
| `Paper.HGP.zLogical H` | `(Paper.HGP.complex H).middleHomology` |
| `Paper.HGP.xLogical H` | `(Paper.HGP.complex H).middleCohomology` |
| `Paper.HGP.firstKernel H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstCode H` |
| `Paper.HGP.secondKernel H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondCode H` |
| `Paper.HGP.firstTransposeKernel H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstTransposeCode H` |
| `Paper.HGP.secondTransposeKernel H` | `QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondTransposeCode H` |

These are aliases, with no new theorem proof. Inherited chain validity is supplied-library mathematics and must not be counted as a newly proved A.

## Fresh mechanical check
The supervisor-selected `target-map.json` selects only the eleven construction aliases from the substantive Model module. The required fresh checker was invoked with CPU affinity 6,7 and 500-second timeout; repeated dependency-graph builds were stopped at the lead reviewer's request to reduce competing expensive imports. Their partial raw outputs remain in `fresh-check-2/` and `model-check/`. The abandoned first room was moved to `fresh-check/fresh-room-preserved/` to prevent follow-up builds; its timeout/failure evidence remains preserved.

The exact original Model source was separately elaborated with trusted `lake env lean`; this timed out after 500 seconds without Lean diagnostics (`direct-model.stdout`). This is not evidence that any particular declaration is invalid. The final low-priority unpinned combined audit under the shared host import lock **passed with exit 0**, using the whole byte-identical source as prefix followed only by supervisor `#check` and `#print axioms` commands (`SupervisorDirectModelAudit.lean`). All eleven abbreviations elaborate. `Data` and `QubitIndex` have no axioms; each remaining abbreviation has only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound` (universe annotations omitted here). See `direct-model-audit.stdout` for the full types and axiom lists, and `direct-audit-report.json` for per-name results. No proof repair or prefix salvage was needed because the substantive module contains no unfinished proof. The sole contestant-source SHA-256 is `7ed11250397e31dba44d058c959b12e590b82c15047d543ab466f387f1b3e314`.

## Verdict
No full A–E goal and no substantial new proved mathematical partial is present. The verified partial is limited to the eleven A construction/semantic aliases if a rubric awards definition scaffolding. Verified novel mathematical statements: **none**. All code is working-draft material, not a submitted complete target bundle.

# Check execution notes

The prescribed fresh checker was run with CPU affinity 6,7 and 500-second per-command timeout, first for all four inventory modules and then for the substantive Model module only. The repeated dependency-graph builds were stopped at the lead reviewer’s request to avoid competing graph jobs. Neither interruption is a contestant proof-failure verdict. Partial raw outputs remain in fresh-check-2/fresh-room/_supervisor_logs/ and model-check/fresh-room/_supervisor_logs/.

Primary verification is exact-source direct Model elaboration via trusted `lake env lean`, followed by an axiom consumer. The sole consumed contestant source hash is 7ed11250397e31dba44d058c959b12e590b82c15047d543ab466f387f1b3e314.

The abandoned first grader room was moved to `fresh-check/fresh-room-preserved` at the lead reviewer’s request to prevent subsequent graph commands from that untracked invocation. Existing evidence is preserved.

The first direct source elaboration timed out after 500 seconds without diagnostics (`direct-model.stdout`). The follow-up appends all eleven declaration and axiom commands to a source-identical full original prefix, and is serialized using the shared host `preflight/grade-import.lock` without taskset. It is not a repaired contestant submission.

The serialized unpinned combined audit completed with room exit 0. All eleven aliases checked; only the permitted standard axioms occur. Raw full types/axioms are in `direct-model-audit.stdout`; the derived per-declaration record is `direct-audit-report.json`. The original exact Model bytes are asserted to be the full prefix of the audited file. No contestant theorem was added or repaired.
